# The Provider System

> Websites and lead systems for West Texas service businesses.

The Provider System is owned and led by John W Johnson. It builds the website customers see and the lead system behind it: local visibility, CRM and lead routing, follow-up, automation, practical AI, and selected custom software for service businesses.

The public site makes no promise of rankings, lead volume, revenue, savings, or perfect AI accuracy. Project stories describe observable delivered scope. Ownership, account access, third-party services, support, and handoff are defined by the project agreement.

## Primary routes

- `/` — West Texas website and lead-system homepage
- `/services` — website, visibility, lead-management, and operating-system services
- `/industries` — operating guides for priority service industries
- `/texas` — West Texas markets and regional project proof
- `/work` — real project archive and responsive previews
- `/playbooks` — 15 practical owner guides
- `/process` — assess, design, build, launch, and handoff process
- `/about` — founder and operating principles
- `/start` — website and lead-flow review request
- `/faq` — project, ownership, AI, and delivery questions

## West Texas coverage

West Texas is the primary market focus. The Provider System is anchored in San Angelo and uses a founder-led, remote-first delivery model. The project record represented on this site includes work connected to San Angelo, Abilene, Anson, the Big Country, the Permian Basin, Lubbock, Midland, Odessa, and broader regional service markets.

Regional routes:

- `/texas/abilene-big-country`
- `/texas/san-angelo-concho-valley`
- `/texas/lubbock`
- `/texas/midland-odessa`

These are service and project markets, not additional Provider System office locations.

## Selected project records

- Total Quality Plumbing — Abilene plumbing and local website architecture

- Mansfield Mining — West Texas and Permian Basin industrial website
- Master Commercial Clean — multi-market West Texas commercial service website
- Abilene Commercial — commercial property platform
- FlowOS — booking, queue, CRM, and operations product

Project previews use stored desktop and mobile launch screenshots. Current client sites remain available through direct project links.
